name: rubotty-dashboard-assets
description: Build step for the dashboard's script editor, standard charts and Series A presentation.

scripts.prebuild: node $(test -f scripts/clean-dashboard-assets.js && echo scripts/clean-dashboard-assets.js || echo clean-dashboard-assets.js)
scripts.build: npm run build:editor && npm run build:swatches && npm run build:civet && npm run build:theme-series-a-civet && npm run build:theme-runtime && npm run build:theme-head && npm run build:theme-boot && npm run build:chart-engine && npm run build:theme-series-a-style
scripts.build:editor: node $(test -f scripts/build-dashboard-bundle.js && echo scripts/build-dashboard-bundle.js || echo build-dashboard-bundle.js) assets/editor/index.js lib/rubotty/dashboard/public/script-editor.js
scripts.build:chart-engine: node $(test -f scripts/build-dashboard-bundle.js && echo scripts/build-dashboard-bundle.js || echo build-dashboard-bundle.js) tmp/themes/runtime/chart-boot.js lib/rubotty/dashboard/public/chart-engine.js
scripts.build:theme-runtime: node $(test -f scripts/build-dashboard-bundle.js && echo scripts/build-dashboard-bundle.js || echo build-dashboard-bundle.js) tmp/themes/runtime/index.js lib/rubotty/dashboard/public/theme-runtime.js rubottyTheme
scripts.build:theme-head: node $(test -f scripts/build-dashboard-bundle.js && echo scripts/build-dashboard-bundle.js || echo build-dashboard-bundle.js) tmp/themes/runtime/head.js lib/rubotty/dashboard/public/theme-head.js
scripts.build:theme-boot: node $(test -f scripts/build-dashboard-bundle.js && echo scripts/build-dashboard-bundle.js || echo build-dashboard-bundle.js) tmp/themes/runtime/boot.js lib/rubotty/dashboard/public/theme-boot.js
scripts.build:theme-series-a-style: sass --no-source-map --style=compressed assets/themes/series-a/style.scss lib/rubotty/dashboard/public/theme-series-a.css && node $(test -f scripts/strip-bom.js && echo scripts/strip-bom.js || echo strip-bom.js) lib/rubotty/dashboard/public/theme-series-a.css
